findings.reason: without a declared test path the node either cannot produce the test its own done-when demands or writes outside its fence, the same write-path omission an earlier review raised against §13.
findings.text: §20's done-when requires "a fixture with a spent global credit lift and a live session credit lift", a test that "fails" on the base commit, and a fallback-path case, but the Change names the write paths as `reckon/crew/dispatch.py` and `reckon/crew/budget_lift.py` "only where the session must be threaded further" and names no test file; an implementer has no declared path to write the required test, and every sibling section names its test file in its write paths (§15 `tests/test_pace_dates_a_rollout_by_its_report.py`, §17 `tests/test_the_preflight_reads_the_lift.py`, §18 `tests/test_the_picker_preflight_names_its_session.py`, §19 `tests/test_a_replayed_pick_reads_its_own_session.py`)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_governing_lift` and `_applies` (reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:1000, :1033), `budget_group.effective_block` (reckon/crew/budget_group.py:220), `_budget_verdict` (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1453 and :1536), `plan_dispatch` and §13 all resolve as cited.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §20's done-when requires a test that reproduces the refusal and fails on the base commit, but the deliverable's write paths name no test file to hold it.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §20 places no evidence or gate log on a scratchpad or node-local path; its Change says to name the dropping call in the gate log, whose location the run-directory convention supplies.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the identifiers §20 cites are runtime lift and session ids (`codex-sub-1792529492-26f087`, `s21-nova`) and code symbols, not plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the defect and the fix are both confirmed on the code path: `dispatch()` does reach `_governing_lift` through `_budget_verdict` → `_config_with_effective_budget` (reckon/crew/routing.py:469) → `budget_group.effective_block` → `budget_lift.effective_budget` (reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:608), and the two `_budget_verdict` calls in `dispatch()` (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1453, :1536) are the only calls in the tree that omit `session=` (the two in reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1272, :1746 pass it), so `_applies` discards the session-scoped lift and the mechanism produces the stated measure.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §20 carries one deliverable: thread the dispatching session into the two `_budget_verdict` calls in `dispatch()` so the credit-cap judgement reads the lift governing that session.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §20 is the plan's only section declared implementable (`plan-section-declarations` s20:implementable), the open followup f-20261022-session-lift (docs/plans/a-window-paces-the-lane.html:2140) recommends `/reckon-build a-window-paces-the-lane §20`, and the plan-level `plan-informs` target resolves (docs/plans/background-agent-fitness-and-dispatch-scope.html).
